name: @mycel/desktop
author: TreeSoop
description: Desktop app: the team's web page plus the in-app browser pane the AI can use. Component E. Name, installer names and electron-builder settings: electron-builder.config.ts (from shared/src/product.ts).

scripts.dist:mac: NODE_ENV=production bun build.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --mac dmg --universal --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: NODE_ENV=production bun build.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: NODE_ENV=production bun build.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: NODE_ENV=production bun build.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --win nsis --x64 --publish never
